text.title: Product Manager Workflows Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for Product Manager Workflows. Required because complexity=deep. Each step has input / action / output and (where applicable) a decision-gate. Then the two pipelines: Seven-phase pipeline from idea to TASK_000, with mandatory Phase 4 user confirmation and the output artifact structure under .aidocs/. And the five-mode MLP pipeline with its artifact chain.

step.name: check-preconditions
step.input: `## Applies If` items, `## Skip If` items, prior-cycle artefact (if any).
step.action: Verify ALL applies-if items hold and NO skip-if item fires.
step.output: boolean `proceed`; if false, log skip reason and exit.
step.decision-gate: If `proceed == false`, conclude with `skip-this-methodology` and stop.

step.name: gather-inputs
step.action: Pull each input artefact from its named source; verify freshness (e.g., ≤7 days where applicable).
step.output: structured input bundle ready for step 3.
step.decision-gate: If any input missing or stale, defer the cycle and record the gap.

step.name: apply-core-rules
step.action: Apply each testable rule in order; record any rule violation with concrete evidence.

step.name: produce-artefact
step.action: Render the artefact (shape defined by JSON Schema in `02-output-contract.xml`).

step.name: validate-and-route
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-workflows.py` against the artefact. On pass, route to downstream consumer; on fail, surface violations.
step.output: validator exit code 0 (pass) or 1 (fail) + violation list.
step.decision-gate: If exit != 0, return artefact for revision; do not advance.

step.name: run-bootstrap-phases
step.action: Phase sequence: 1. Vision Brainstorm (Five Whys to real need) → 2. Tech Stack Selection (frontend, backend, database) → 3. MVP Definition (max 3-5 features, cut 50% nice-to-haves) → 4. User Confirmation (MANDATORY — present summary, get explicit approval) → 5. Backlog Creation (feature specs with FR/AC) → 6. Constitution (write project constitution) → 7. TASK_000 (setup task with project goals).
step.decision-gate: If Phase 4 yields no explicit approval token, hard-fail with NEEDS-HUMAN (rule phase-4-no-simulated-approval).

step.name: run-mlp-modes
step.input: Shipped MVP with telemetry (rule mlp-propose-after-telemetry); competitive-analysis.md.
step.action: Run analyze → find-gaps → propose → update → plan per rule mlp-modes-resume-from-checkpoint.
step.output: Output artifacts: product_docs/mvp-scope-analysis.md (analyze), product_docs/mlp-analysis-report.md (find-gaps), product_docs/mlp-implementation-order.md (plan). Each file is the input to the next mode.
step.decision-gate: If WOW feature count exceeds 7 or any WOW feature lacks a scope-analysis row, stop and apply rules wow-cap-seven and wow-feature-cites-scope-analysis.
